_comment: Copy this file to config.json and edit that copy -- config.json is gitignored, this example isn't. Every field here is optional: case_brief.py has a built-in default for all of them, and every one can also be set with a command-line flag (which wins over this file). Run `python case_brief.py -h` to see them, or `python case_brief.py -i` for an interactive prompt instead of editing this file at all.

azure_devops._comment: project: leave null to search every project in the org (slower, but you don't need to know which one holds the relevant repo).

customer_repo_map._comment: Optional. The 'Useful Commands' section auto-guesses a repo by fuzzy-matching the CRM customer name against ADO project/repo names -- add an entry here only to override a wrong/ambiguous guess for a specific customer.
